title: Per-repository bootstrap correctness for multi-repo Claude cloud containers
objective: Remove the recurring friction observed while executing the l9cr-context-compiler-pr-pack-v2 contract against Quantum-L9/l9-cognitive-runtime: make the Cursor-Governance cloud bootstrap resolve every repository in a multi-repo container instead of only the container root, and make readiness receipts bind to the governance revision they were produced against.
success_criteria: l9-cognitive-runtime pytest is 184 passed / 0 failed with no dangling bootstrap symlinks in the tree (baseline today: 2 failed, 182 passed)
find /home/user/*/.claude -xtype l returns zero entries after a SessionStart in a multi-repo container (baseline today: 16 across 4 repos)

uv sync --locked --extra dev --dry-run reports zero package deltas in every detected repository after SessionStart (baseline today: 3 deltas in l9-cognitive-runtime including a missing declared dependency)
the session-deps banner names each repository it provisioned and its per-repo outcome, and never reports 'toolchain ready' for a repository whose lock is unapplied

claude_bootstrap_receipt.py reports state UNKNOWN when receipt.governance_revision does not equal the live governance HEAD, and SessionStart re-runs the installer instead of reprinting a stale DEGRADED verdict
make claude-env exits 0 in a correctly bootstrapped multi-repo container (baseline today: exit 5 on every session)

todos.task: Extract the per-repository workspace-root resolver into a shared library. memory_prefetch._hydration_roots() is the only correct multi-repo detector in the bootstrap (children of the workspace with a .git entry, sorted, capped at 6). Promote it verbatim to a shared module and make memory_prefetch import it, so one definition of 'which repositories is this session working in' exists.
todos.anchor: new module; memory_prefetch keeps its public behavior and cap

todos.task: Reconcile per-repository .claude mirrors. The claude-code-project projection adapter targets /home/user/.claude, so per-repo .claude/skills and .claude/commands mirrors created by earlier single-repo sessions sit outside every reconciler's target set and keep symlinks to skills the SSOT has removed. Iterate workspace_roots and apply the existing stale-removal path (reconcile_claude_l9_skills.remove_managed) to each repository mirror; report removals per repository in the projection receipt.
todos.anchor: reconcile_claude_l9_skills.py stale loop at 'for stale in sorted(previous - set(desired))'

todos.task: Make session_deps_cloud.sh provision each detected repository. Today --workspace receives /home/user, which holds no manifest, so the fingerprint degenerates to tool versions, toolchain_present() can never return true, and the install pass is a no-op that still reports 'toolchain ready'. Loop workspace_roots, fingerprint and stamp per repository, and aggregate a per-repo banner line.
todos.anchor: WORKSPACE assignment and the fingerprint()/toolchain_present() pair

todos.task: Make the deps stamp assert applied state, not attempted state. Add a post-install proof per repository: uv sync --locked --check (or an equivalent lock-vs-environment probe) plus an import smoke of the repo's own package, and refuse to write the stamp or emit 'toolchain ready' unless the proof passes. This is the detector that would have caught RC-1 on the day it started.
todos.anchor: DEPS_FAILED accounting and the outer stamp-on-clean-run branch

todos.task: Bind bootstrap receipt freshness to the governance revision. claude_bootstrap_receipt.py carries governance_revision through but expires on wall-clock TTL only, so a DEGRADED verdict produced against a superseded governance revision is reported as current. Return UNKNOWN with reason 'revision superseded' when the recorded revision differs from live governance HEAD.
todos.shared_root_cause: RC-2 time-based rather than revision-based readiness

todos.task: Re-run the installer when the receipt is UNKNOWN or DEGRADED instead of reprinting it. SessionStart prints the receipt's own remediation string but never executes it, so a degraded verdict is inherited indefinitely. Invoke the adapter installer bounded and fail-open, then re-read the receipt so the banner reports post-repair state.
todos.shared_root_cause: RC-2 time-based rather than revision-based readiness

todos.task: Publish an observed GitHub transport truth-table for this surface and correct the stale prior-art record. gh is installed at /usr/bin/gh and gh api succeeds through the agent proxy, while gh auth status reports the GH_TOKEN sentinel invalid and still exits 0. Record which transports are proven working, mark rule 62's PAT-resolution path inapplicable on a model-controlled surface, and supersede P307 CR-105/CR-124 ('no gh CLI exists'), which the current container falsifies.
todos.shared_root_cause: RC-3 documented capability contradicts observed transport

todos.task: Seed agent-authority docs in l9-cognitive-runtime. It is the only in-scope repository with no CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, INVARIANTS.md or ARCHITECTURE.md, which is why the PR pack has to ship INVARIANTS.md for verbatim copy as step 3 of its own execution order. Add the authority pointer and invariants index so repo law is loadable without a pack.
todos.anchor: repository root; mirror the Cursor-Governance CLAUDE.md authority-pointer shape
todos.shared_root_cause: RC-4 repo law absent from the repository

todos.task: Replace the standing publish breakglass with a scoped expiring receipt. L9_PUBLISH_PATH_OVERRIDE is exported into every session carrying the literal text 'one-time breakglass authorized by user', so a one-time authorization has become permanent configuration. Move it to a receipt with an issued-at and a TTL that the execution gate reads.
todos.anchor: the L9_PUBLISH_PATH_OVERRIDE read in the publish-path branch
todos.shared_root_cause: RC-5 standing authority from a one-time grant

doc_root_surface_impact.reason: the 'Receipts expire' section describes TTL-only semantics that T5 replaces with revision binding
SessionStart activation contract gains per-repository provisioning and an applied-state proof
PAT resolution is not performable on a model-controlled surface where gh already works through the proxy
no governance invariant changes; this plan repairs implementations of existing invariants

disconfirming_questions: Is the empty deps log actually caused by the container root, or by a cache hit? Answered: the fingerprint was reproduced byte-for-byte from tool versions with zero manifests present, and toolchain_present() tests paths that cannot exist at the container root, so neither branch could have installed anything.

Are the two pytest failures pre-existing product defects rather than bootstrap residue? Answered: the failing paths are untracked and gitignored (.gitignore:31 /.claude/), the working tree is otherwise clean, and the link targets are exactly the three skills this session's own projection receipt lists as removed.

Does per-repository provisioning simply move the cost into the SessionStart budget? The 20s budget with detached continuation already exists; per-repo work must reuse it, and a container at the cap of 6 repositories must still return a banner within budget.

Would revision-binding receipts cause a repair loop on every session, since cloud SessionStart resets governance to origin/main each time? This is the main risk in T5+T6 and is why C4 can ship T5 without T6.

Is the prior P307 pack already the fix, making this rework? No: P307 CR-113 states RC-2 identically and is unbuilt, and its PROGRESS.md diagnoses the empty deps log as 'no import smoke' — a detector, not the cause. RC-1 is new.
assumed_false_ifs: if the per-repo .claude mirrors are actually consumed by a session (they are not: the effective project scope is /home/user/.claude), then removing their stale entries could deactivate skills rather than only clearing residue
if any repository legitimately needs a .venv that diverges from its lock, then T4's applied-state proof would fail a correct environment
if a repository in the container is not meant to be provisioned at all, iterating all roots wastes budget and may run untrusted install hooks
stress_test.blast_radius: SessionStart runs on every session of every governed cloud workspace, so a defect in T3 or T6 degrades or stalls every future session rather than one repository. T2 unlinks files inside consumer repositories; scoped wrongly it could remove tracked content. T9 touches the publish-path gate and is the only high-risk item; it is deliberately last and off the critical path.
stress_test.rollback: Each TODO is an independent commit on a branch from origin/main. Revert order is reverse-dependency (T4, T3, T2, T1). The bootstrap is fail-open by construction: reverting restores the current behavior, which is degraded but non-blocking. T2 removals are recoverable because the mirrors are untracked, gitignored, and regenerable by the projection; no tracked file is deleted. T9 reverts to reading the environment variable.

shared_causes: RC-1: the bootstrap treats WORKSPACE as one repository, but a cloud container holds many; only memory_prefetch iterates repositories, and it is the one plane that works
RC-2: readiness is time-bound rather than revision-bound, so a verdict outlives the artifacts it describes
RC-3: documented capability contradicts observed transport, so agents route around a working path or trust a false negative
RC-4: repository law lives in delivery packs rather than in the repository
RC-5: a one-time grant persists as standing configuration
deletions_or_consolidations: delete the second workspace-root notion: memory_prefetch._hydration_roots becomes the single definition, consumed by the deps helper and the projection adapters instead of each re-deriving one
consolidate the deps stamp so it records applied state, retiring the attempted-state stamp that produced a false 'toolchain ready'
supersede P307 CR-105 and CR-124 rather than carrying a record the current container falsifies

risks.risk: T2 unlinks a path inside a consumer repository that is tracked or author-authored
risks.mitigation: operate only on entries the projection recorded as managed, assert the path is a symlink into the governance SSOT, and assert git check-ignore before removal; refuse on any tracked path

risks.risk: per-repository provisioning exceeds the SessionStart budget in a container at the 6-repo cap and stalls the session
risks.mitigation: keep the existing bounded-run and self-detach design, apply the budget across the whole loop rather than per repository, and keep the helper fail-open with exit 0

risks.risk: T5 plus T6 produce a repair loop because cloud SessionStart resets governance to origin/main on every session, changing the revision the receipt must match
risks.mitigation: write the receipt with the post-reset revision and re-probe at most once per session, guarded by a per-session marker; ship T5 alone if C4 shows non-convergence

risks.risk: T4's applied-state proof fails on a repository whose lock is legitimately unappliable in the container, converting a silent degradation into a loud one on every session
risks.mitigation: report per-repository status rather than a single verdict, and keep the helper fail-open so a failing repository degrades that repository only

risks.risk: this plan overlaps unbuilt P307 improvements and creates a competing record set
risks.mitigation: T5 and T6 are recorded as the implementation of CI-004 for CR-113, T3 and T4 extend CI-028, and T7 supersedes CR-105 and CR-124 explicitly rather than adding parallel records
